scope: Eight published baselines adapted explicitly to grounding; six transfers, DEV768 first, original A256 endpoints, all protected aliases fallback without media or GT access. Additional source training and pretrained models baseline-only.

fast.Tent: BN1d/2d target statistics + affine entropy, SGD1e-3 momentum.9, one episodic step, original pre/post both retained
fast.MEMO: All existing native backbone/text/matching parameters, 3 mild raw-point noise augmentations, physical-anchor assignment, average marginal entropy, official transformer AdamW1e-5 wd.01, BN prior16. No real adjacent-frame A/B/C substitution.
fast.EATA: Episodic3 view proposals, entropy<.4ln256, redundancy cosine<.05 on this input anchored candidate inventory only, source-unlabeled16 Fisher/alpha2000. No candidate-class history across different descriptions. Anti-forgetting inactive when only first update accepted: explicitly report.
fast.token_readout: existing native subject mask and token log-odds, candidate softmax; do not retune masks
fast.positions: original six decoder positions and256 physical source query anchors fixed; full backbone and text recomputed
fast.scoring: all DEV768 equally per direction; all scene/task rows and negatives retained; compare raw and same-information no-update controls

hard_methods: Each must satisfy its source preparation and architectural prerequisites; do not fill unavailable methods with generic renamed update. Separate per-method design lock before its training/inference.
